item.title: How to turn liquid glass into a solid interface
item.description:
📝 Reduce Transparency The setting that makes the most difference in toning down the excesses of Liquid Glass is System Settings > Accessibility > Display > Reduce Transparency. Liquid Glass Off Recently, Bob Pony revealed on Bluesky that there’s a hidden setting in macOS that lets you turn off Liquid Glass entirely. Liquid Glass Off, Reduce Transparency On What disabling Liquid Glass doesn’t do—reasonably enough—is turn off transparency.
🔗 Read more: https://tidbits.com/2025/10/09/how-to-turn-liquid-glass-into-a-solid-interface/
